items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: Richard Hayman, who I became good friends with and became the assistant conductor of the orchestra here in Boca Raton that he had for many years.

ctx.x: Did you write your own parts?

Yes. No at that point, at that point he introduced me to a copyist. And also a little history with the copyist, he wound up copying most of the music for the Boston Pops. Because Richard Hayman was a client of his. Later on in life I started writing arrangements for Richard Hayman, who I became good friends with and became the assistant conductor of the orchestra here in Boca Raton that he had for many years.
Did you write your scores in concert pitch or did you transpose the transposing instruments in the score?
